description.value: The Sorrento Lakeview Inn is a 22-room lakeside motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sorrento, BC, operated as part of the Shuswap Resorts complex on the shores of Shuswap Lake. Room options range from standard queen/double units with lake-view balconies to kitchenette suites with private patios, and guests have access to the resort's beach and water-sports rentals. A coin-operated laundromat and showers are available at the adjacent RV park area, and the Copper Island Pub is a short walk away.
